Cortex XDR
Detect More Attacks in Real Time with AI
Endpoints are the #1 target, but 84% of attacks span multiple vectors. Cortex XDR
®
connects data from endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and email sources and applies AI to detect and prioritize cyberattacks, no matter where they come from.
Cortex XDR
Prevent Endpoint Threats with Industry-Leading Accuracy
Cyberattacks will try to compromise your endpoints in multiple ways, and you have to be ready. Cortex XDR features prevention modules tailored to stop every technique used in modern attacks, from zero-day exploits to fileless malware, hijacking legitimate processes — and whatever comes next.

Get to the Root Cause and Cut Investigation Time to Minutes
Once an adversary gains initial access, the race is on. Uncover the execution path of every alert and run native automation to disrupt the attack in minutes. The Cortex AgentiX Assistant equips your SOC with a fleet of adaptive AI agents that investigate and respond at machine speed.
Cortex XDR
One Agent. One Total Protection.
Expand XDR with industry-leading NG-SIEM, Endpoint Data Loss Prevention, Exposure Management, Email Security, and Cloud Security—all unified within a single analyst experience on the Cortex Platform.
